'''Sanae Kobayashi''' (Japanese: '''小林沙苗''' ''Kobayashi Sanae'') is a Japanese voice actress for the {{pkmn|animated series}}. She was born on January 26, 1980 in {{wp|Shizuoka Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Kobayashi began to provide voices for the {{pkmn|animated series}} in {{aniseries|RS}} as various [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. Her most famous role is that of [[Greta]].
